snippet.title: Scroll Shop Trailer (MV)
snippet.description:
Welcome to Scroll Shop. ✨
Customers arrive with problems. Your job is to understand what they need, work with the magic at your disposal and craft the scroll you believe will give them the right answer.
In Scroll Shop, magic follows its own rules. Learn how it works, discover new possibilities and decide how each problem should be solved.
Scroll Shop is coming to PC. Wishlist now on Steam!

🔮 Puzzle · Crafting
📜 Single-player
🎮 Developed in Unity

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5080620/Scroll_Shop/
Website: https://www.indiedir.com

#ScrollShop #IndieGame #IndieDev #unity #games #crafting
